newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Russia drops ARS diamond firm money investigation.
newsitem.headline: Russia drops ARS diamond firm money investigation.

text.p: Russia's tax police have dropped an investigation into alleged hard-currency violations by the Almazy Rossii-Sakha (ARS) diamond-producing monopoly, the company said in statement on Wednesday.
It said the investigation, launched in November 1996, had been cancelled for lack of evidence of wrongdoing.
ARS is the negotiating partner to South Africa's De Beers in a stalled diamond export deal that could soon be approved by the government.
Finance Minister Alexander Livshits, quoted by Interfax news agency last November, had said ARS could have faced fines of $379 million for the alleged currency violations.
De Beers last year cancelled its interim arrangement after Russia failed to approve or reject a new trade deal, and had said that the currency investigation had not helped matters.
ARS said earlier this month that some unspecified changes had been made to the draft text of the deal, which officials have said could be signed in March.
